'''Vorgath''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was influenced by the [[Dread Masters]] into joining the [[Dread Host]] on [[Denova]]. He was [[Death/Legends|slain]] in [[Battle of Denova|battle]] in [[3639 BBY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vorgath appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a boss in the "Explosive Conflict" operation.
